item.description: The Lower Tavern sat halfway down the hill from Obissian Castle, in the part of Blackswain where people still had enough coin to drink but not enough to care who watched them do it. Issah had been here three days…

item.title: Chapter 1: The Cave and the Light
item.description: Eri goes underground after a story nobody believes, looking for proof she can carry home in a jar. What she finds past the flood breaks every rule she was taught about how the world works — and it will not survive the climb back to daylight.
